Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software, de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Backend.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, transformando requisitos em software robusto, seguro e escalável, alinhado às necessidades do negócio;
  • Atuar na análise e evolução da arquitetura de software, assegurando organização, consistência, performance e eficiência de seus componentes;
  • Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes automatizados, versionamento, revisões de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Detalhar requisitos técnicos complexos em colaboração com clientes e áreas envolvidas, traduzindo demandas de negócio em soluções viáveis;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;
  • Participar de discussões táticas e operacionais, contribuindo na definição de metas anuais, estudos de viabilidade técnica e escolhas estratégicas de tecnologia;
  • Orientar, capacitar e apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio, arquitetura e design, promovendo disseminação de conhecimento e boas práticas;
  • Criar frameworks, componentes reutilizáveis e padrões técnicos quando necessário para acelerar e qualificar o desenvolvimento;
  • Definir, revisar e aprimorar processos de engenharia que suportem os objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área de atuação;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Contribuir em fóruns e discussões sobre inovação e tendências de mercado, disseminando conhecimento e fortalecendo a cultura de aprendizado constante;
  • Atuar diretamente na resolução de incidentes, investigando causas raiz e implementando melhorias que aumentem a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da plataforma;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE);

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL e MongoDB – Nível avançado;

● Arquitetura de Software (cloudnative, web, microsserviços);

● DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar);

● Sistemas Distribuídos, Escalabilidade, Resiliência (nível intermediário);

● Mensageria (RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub ou equivalente);

● NoSQL (Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente);

● Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage ou equivalente);

● Processamento distribuído (Hadoop, Spark);

● Pipelines de dados/streaming (Apache Beam, Dataflow, Airflow);

● Processamento assíncrono (Celery, Temporal IO);

● MCP;

● Copilot ou equivalente;

● Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes);

● Design Patterns;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros);

● Observabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações em produção (logs estruturados,

métricas, traces).

title: Back End Developer
description:
Backend Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Content Systems – Convergence team. In this role, you will design, build, and scale backend services that power content platforms used at scale. You will work closely with product, platform, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance systems in a modern cloud-native environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js
  • Build and optimize content-focused backend systems with high availability and performance
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions
  • Deploy, monitor, and manage services using Kubernetes
  • Work with cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP
  • Ensure best practices in system design, security, observability, and performance
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align backend solutions with product needs
  • Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical decision-making
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and best practices

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong experience building Node.js backend services in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines , especially GitHub Actions
  • Solid experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
  • Proven experience working with AWS and GCP cloud platforms
  • Strong understanding of modern backend architecture and infrastructure tooling
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and distributed systems

title: Content Designer lll
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.



Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Business Analyst Trainee — Marketing Automation & AI
description:
Type: 90‑day, full‑time remote internship/trainee program (paid)

Pay: USD $1,000 / month

Contract: Independent contractor (Canada‑based company)

Future: Outstanding interns may receive a full‑time offer.

Non-negotiable requirement: Advanced English


Ready to Apply? We value thoughtful applications over quick submissions. Please send short introduction video to j Include any relevant experience or examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in building things.


Alternatively, you will receive an automated email to prepare a one-way video interview as the first step of the hiring process.


What You’ll Do

  • Build from zero: Stand up internal marketing‑agency systems, analytics stacks, and repeatable processes—often with no existing playbook.
  • Automate & optimize: Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and deploy no‑code/low‑code, AI, or integration tools (Cursor, Replit, Zapier, Make, GPT, etc.) to streamline them.
  • Turn data into insight: Design dashboards and translate numbers into actionable narratives for stakeholders.
  • Ship & educate: Draft launch content, craft go‑to‑market strategies, and create user‑friendly training to ensure adoption.


You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • Learn fast: You welcome constructive pushback and treat every project as a chance to sharpen your craft.
  • Love variety: Each day’s challenges differ—expect context switching and rapid iteration.
  • Communicate crisply: Advanced written and spoken English is non‑negotiable.
  • Stay curious: New tech doesn’t scare you; you experiment until it bends to the problem.


Core Skills…

  • Professional/Bilingual proficiency in English. All business activities require an advanced level of English
  • Business writing & stakeholder persuasion
  • Familiarity with no‑code / AI automation platforms
  • Data literacy & visualization sense
  • Project management fundamentals

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging Sales and Revenue executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email sales executives (VP of Sales, Head of Sales, Chief Revenue Officer, CEO) to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

title: Talent Manager(Non Code)
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is fully remote and CLT model and salary range is 20k-28k BRL/mo.


Must‑haves:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

title: Auxiliar de produção de Equipamentos Eletrônicos
description:
Buscamos AUXILIAR DE PRODUÇÃO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS na Montagem de produtos eletrônicos .

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 32 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades

O “Auxiliar de Produção ” desempenha um papel fundamental na linha de produção. Suas principais atividades e responsabilidades incluem:

  • Executar a instalação de componentes, sistemas eletrônicos e equipamentos
  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Realizar atividades operacionais tais como recebimento de materiais e produtos para produção
  • Organização, limpeza e zelo pelos materiais e recursos necessários ao trabalho
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Ensino médio em andamento
  • Coordenação motora
  • Atenção concentrada
  • Senso de segurança

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • Ensino médio completo
  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência em produção e montagem de produtos

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR
  • Plano de saúde ambulatorial e odonto após contrato de experiência
  • PPLR
  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Vinculo: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada: Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho: Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: Estagiário
description:
ATENÇÃO

SOMENTE SERÃO ACEITAS CANDIDATURAS CONFORME ORIENTAÇÕES ABAIXO, PORTANTO, LEIA COM CRITÉRIO.

Sobre a UniCarbo:

A UniCarbo é uma empresa brasileira líder no mercado de créditos de carbono do setor de resíduos na América Latina.

Com 20 anos de experiência e projetos em mais de 10 países a UniCarbo é uma one stop shop que atende os principais players do mercado de resíduos.

Combinando expertise no monitoramento e emissão de créditos de carbono, com a operação de projetos, mais do que uma empresa de consultoria, a UniCarbo representa hoje um verdadeiro facilitador de projetos, entregando serviços de alta qualidade.

Ao longo de suas operações nos últimos anos, a UniCarbo esteve diretamente envolvida nos processos de certificação e emissão de mais de 50 Milhões de créditos de carbono principalmente gerados em mais de 100 projetos de biogás de aterros sanitários. Um dos maiores portfólios do mundo. 

 Sobre a vaga:

A UniCarbo cresceu mais de 200% nos últimos 3 anos e procura consolidar um time com competências específicas, oferecendo treinamento com o objetivo de uma posterior integração na equipe.

  • Interesse na área de mudança climática/aquecimento global, Protocolo de Kyoto, Acordo de Paris e convenção sobre mudança climática;
  • Interesse em mecanismos de redução de emissões de gases do efeito estufa (GEEs), Protocolo de Quioto, Acordo de Paris e em outros mercados de carbono;
  • Interesse na caracterização das emissões (medição, monitoramento, cálculos);
  • Interesse no campo das tecnologias ambientalmente corretas para eliminação de resíduos sólidos urbanos, geração de energia (energias renováveis), etc.
  • Bons conhecimentos de ferramentas MS Office (Word, Excel);
  • Boa capacidade analítica;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de curto prazo a locais de projeto no Brasil e no exterior, mediante planejamento prévio;
  • Disponibilidade para realizar o estágio de 6 horas por dia.

Habilidades de comunicação requeridas:

Todas as atividades são desenvolvidas em língua inglesa, portanto, é essencial uma forte capacidade de comunicação em inglês. Enquanto a maioria das atividades estará relacionada a projetos de redução de emissões localizados não apenas no Brasil, mas também na América do Sul e Central, as habilidades de comunicação em língua espanhola são uma vantagem.

Atividades a serem empreendidas como parte do estágio:

  • Prestação de apoio em atividades relacionadas com o funcionamento e monitoramento de projetos de crédito de carbono;
  • Fornecimento de apoio na compilação de relatórios e ferramentas de cálculo relacionadas a projetos de crédito de carbono;
  • Fornecimento de apoio na revisão, análise de dados e cálculo de projetos de redução de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE);
  • Prestação de apoio na operação de participação em auditorias internas e externas.

ATENÇÃO: NÃO SERÃO ACEITAS CANDIDATURAS POR OUTROS MEIOS EXCETO O DISPONIBILIZADO ABAIXO 

Caso tenha interesse na vaga, preencher formulário:

Bolsa: R$ 1.600,00

Para saber mais sobre nós, acesse:

Site: unicarbo.com.br

Redes Sociais: instagram.com/unicarbo_

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a proactive DevOps Engineer who enjoys building, automating, and maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure. You take ownership of environments end to end from access management and CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes workloads and you thrive in fast-paced environments where stability, security, and scalability are critical. You’re looking for a role where you can grow your cloud expertise, influence infrastructure decisions, and collaborate closely with engineering teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services, particularly IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Solid background designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and container orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python and/or Bash (desirable).
  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, permissions, and access management.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

  • Será um diferencial possuir experiência no setor de seguros, investimentos e crédito, conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM e fluência em mais de um idioma.

title: SDR - PRÉ VENDEDOR
description:
Descrição da Empresa Caf seguros faz parte do grupo ávila, empresa atuante no mercado financeiro: investimentos, credito e seguros.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um SDR - Pré Vendedor para integrar nossa equipe na CAF Seguros. O(a) profissional será responsável por identificar, qualificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de negócio, alimentar o pipeline de vendas e realizar o contato inicial com potenciais clientes. Além disso, deverá estabelecer uma comunicação eficaz para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e direcioná-los ao time de vendas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e desempenhado remotamente.

Qualificações

  • Vendas Internas e Geração de Leads: Experiência em vendas internas e identificação de potenciais clientes para gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento: Habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação para construir e manter bons relacionamentos com clientes e equipes internas.
  • Negócios e Desenvolvimento: Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de negócios e estratégias para impulsionar vendas e resultados.
  • Será um diferencial possuir experiência no setor de seguros, investimentos e crédito, conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM e fluência em mais de um idioma.

title: Advogado Tributário (Remoto)
description:
Advogado Tributário


Início Imediato / 100% Remoto


Remuneração Inicial entre R$4.000 e R$5.000, a depender da experiência.


Qualificações:


  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em contencioso tributário (judicial e administrativo) em escritório de advocacia;
  • 2 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em consultoria tributária (desejável);
  • Experiência em Big Four (diferencial);
  • Pós-graduação de Direito Tributário (diferencial);


Principais Atividades:


  • Atuar em demandas judiciais e administrativas tributárias e fiscais;
  • Analisar publicações e controlar seus respectivos prazos;
  • Prestar atendimento eficiente aos clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara e transparente;
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas abrangentes para embasar estratégias de defesa;
  • Colaborar com colegas de equipe para desenvolver e implementar estratégias jurídicas eficazes;
  • Atuar na consultoria tributária envolvendo Tributos Diretos e Indiretos;
  • Elaborar respostas a consultas e memorandos sobre temas variados ligados ao Direito Tributário;
  • Avaliar regimes tributários especiais e benefícios fiscais aplicáveis;
  • Planejamento tributário estratégico, incluindo reorganizações societárias.


Sobre o Santos Varella Advocacia


  • O Santos Varella Advocacia é um escritório de advocacia especializado em Direito Tributário, Direito Empresarial e Direito Civil. Com equipe de profissionais qualificados com mais de 15 anos de excelência no mercado, atuamos na consultoria e no contencioso. Nosso diferencial está na vasta experiência de nossos profissionais, cujo histórico abrange setores jurídicos de grandes escritórios e empresas multinacionais.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Frontend
description:
Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software , de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Frontend.

Conhecimentos Específicos Desejáveis:

- Lógica de Programação;

- Arquitetura de Software (noções);

- APIs REST;

- Banco de Dados SQL Relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente)(Opcional);

- Testes Automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Karma ou equivalentes);

- DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar) (opcional);

- Feature Flags e estratégias de deploy (opcional);

- Cache (Redis) (Opcional);

- Copilot ou equivalente (opcional)

- Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes)(pelo menos 1)

- Design Patterns (opcional)

- Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros)

- Angular (incluindo Angular 18+)

- Typescript (tipagem estática e POO)

- Javascript avançado(opcional)

- HTML e CSS

- Node.js básico (para ferramentas de build e execução de apps)

- React ou Vue (opcional)

- Experiência em otimização de performance em grandes aplicações front-end (opcional)

- Experiência em A11y (acessibilidade) (opcional)

- Integração com mensageria em tempo real (WebSockets, Pub/Sub)(opcional)

- Métodos ágeis

description:

• Implantar contratos junto às operadoras.

• Realizar onboarding completo do corretor.

• Atuar como ponte entre vendas, clientes e operadoras.

• Fazer gestão ativa da carteira para retenção e renovação.

• Prevenir cancelamentos e estornos de comissão.

Requisitos Técnicos:

• Pacote Office (Excel).

• Boa escrita e comunicação ativa/receptiva.

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo.

Perfil Desejado:

Organização, proatividade, responsabilidade, visão de dono, boa comunicação, resiliência, foco em resultado, espírito de equipe e mentalidade voltada para retenção e experiência do cliente.

Benefícios:

Salário R$ 2.200 + VA (R$ 800) + VT (R$ 220) + Plano de Saúde + Odonto + Day Off.

Bonificação por performance: até 50% do salário.

title: Analista de Sistemas Sr Fullstack (React Native)
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?


Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar no desenvolvimento, monitoramento e sustentação dos processos da squad , participando ativamente da evolução técnica das aplicações e garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

Principais responsabilidades

✔ Desenvolver, monitorar e sustentar aplicações da squad

✔ Atuar em ambientes cloud AWS , com foco em arquitetura e boas práticas

✔ Trabalhar com integrações backend e frontend

✔ Apoiar melhorias contínuas de performance, estabilidade e acessibilidade

✔ Atuar de forma colaborativa com o time técnico

title: Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional
description:
Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Months



This role will be SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration - experience is required.


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

* Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

* Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

* Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

* Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)

Functional Process Data Ownership


Responsibilities include:

* Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

* Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

* Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

* Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

* Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

* Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

* Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

* Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

* Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

* Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

* Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

* Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

* Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

* Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

* Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications Experience

* 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

* Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

* Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

* Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

* Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

* Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

* Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

* Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

* Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

* Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

* Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

* Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

* Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

They have a customized system, so it will take time for worker to come up to speed.

Must have strong SAP knowledge, understand fields and how they can be used.

Knowledge of master data is not critical, most data will be OTC, A/R data pricing, customer, pricing tables.

Must have recent SAP experience over the last 3 years.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.


To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent mindset while enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value candidates with full software lifecycle experience, encompassing requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing support.


Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of backend development experience, preferably within the hedge fund or financial services industry
  • Strong passion for backend architecture and application development, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Building and optimizing high-load, high-performance, data-driven backend systems
  • Designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services
  • Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Gerente de Marketing Digital
description:
Resumo da Vaga

Estamos à procura de um Gerente de Marketing Digital dinâmico e com visão estratégica para liderar as iniciativas de marketing online da empresa. Nesta função, você será responsável por planejar, implementar e otimizar campanhas de marketing digital multicanal, com o objetivo de aumentar o reconhecimento da marca, impulsionar as vendas, gerar leads e maximizar o ROI. Esta posição desempenha um papel essencial na definição e execução da estratégia de comunicação digital da organização.


Principais Responsabilidades


Desenvolver e implementar estratégias abrangentes de marketing digital, incluindo SEO, SEM, publicidade paga (Google Ads, Meta Ads), email marketing, redes sociais, marketing de conteúdo e remarketing.


Analisar o mercado, o comportamento do consumidor e as tendências digitais para otimizar campanhas e orientar decisões estratégicas.


Planejar e gerenciar o orçamento de marketing, garantindo uma distribuição eficiente dos investimentos em publicidade.


Monitorar, avaliar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, Taxa de Conversão, Tráfego, Engajamento) para assegurar o cumprimento das metas (KPIs).


Gerenciar a equipe de marketing digital, composta por profissionais de SEO, mídia paga, conteúdo e design.


Colaborar com outros departamentos (vendas, branding, produto) para garantir alinhamento e consistência nas campanhas.


Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e tecnologias emergentes no setor de marketing digital e aplicá-las às estratégias da empresa.


Requisitos


Formação superior em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas relacionadas.


Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em marketing digital, incluindo experiência em liderança de equipe ou gestão de projetos.


Sólido conhecimento em plataformas de publicidade digital (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads...) e ferramentas de análise (Google Analytics, Data Studio, CRM...).


Habilidade em liderança, pensamento estratégico e análise de dados.


Excelentes competências de comunicação, organização e tomada de decisão.

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018

  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Desenvolvedor Front-End Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente do segmento industrial e de tecnologia , em um projeto global , com atuação em times multidisciplinares e foco em inovação, performance e experiência do usuário.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces web modernas, responsivas e performáticas
  • Criar e gerenciar componentes reutilizáveis com React e/ou Angular
  • Implementar layouts responsivos utilizando HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, Grid e media queries
  • Integrar aplicações frontend com APIs REST
  • Aplicar boas práticas de JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript
  • Versionar código utilizando Git
  • Realizar debug e testes básicos com ferramentas do navegador e frameworks de teste
  • Atuar em colaboração com designers, backend developers e stakeholders em ambientes ágeis


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com React (Components, JSX, Hooks, Props, State) e/ou Angular (Modules, Components, Directives, Services)
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript
  • Domínio de HTML5, CSS3 e design responsivo
  • Experiência com integração de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de debug e testes básicos (Jest ou Jasmine/Karma)

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe
  • Perfil colaborativo, organizado e proativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e projetos globais


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: High School Spanish Teacher
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

To plan and deliver effective Spanish language instruction that supports students’ linguistic, cultural, and academic development, while fostering their social and emotional growth. The teacher will collaborate with colleagues, engage with families, and contribute to the school community to promote a dynamic and inclusive learning environment.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Communicate and liaise regularly with fellow Spanish and World Language team members regarding planning, assessment, parent communication, curriculum development, and classroom issues such as behavior and student engagement.

Collaborate with other school colleagues to support students’ social, emotional, and academic growth.

Take an active role in classroom management and positive behavioral support.

Attend and contribute constructively to department and staff meetings.

Supervise students during breaks or transitions, as assigned.

Coordinate and lead class activities, language-learning projects, or cultural experiences as needed.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of student attendance, lesson planning,

assessment, reporting, and parent communication.

Establish and maintain effective communication with families to keep them informed of student progress and classroom expectations.

Participate in and support school-wide events, language fairs, international celebrations, and other community activities

Certifications and Education - Required

Bachelor’s degree in Spanish, Education, or a related fi eld.

Valid teaching certifi cation/license.

IB training and certifi cation.

Desired

Master’s degree in Language or related discipline.

Experience

Experience teaching Spanish at the high school level.

Professional experience teaching IB Language A: Language & Literature or Literature, with a strong understanding of DP standards, assessment criteria, and internal/external moderation processes.

Desired

Experience teaching in international or multicultural contexts.

Experience supporting students with diverse learning profi les in rigorous academic settings.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Extensive familiarity with the literature, culture, and academic conventions of the Spanish-speaking world, grounded in lived experience.

Ability to differentiate instruction for all learners

Understanding of inquiry

Understanding of Competencies based learning

Experience with moderation of assessments in a collaborative setting

title: AI & Data Solutions Engineer
description:
About Plexus:

Founded by former leaders from Google, Plexus is a strategic consultancy that bridges the power of data, artificial intelligence, and technology to transform business growth. Our culture is built on technical excellence, a data-driven mindset, and a focus on sophisticated, scalable solutions.

The Role:

Your mission will be to work with our clients to design and implement cutting-edge AI/ML and data solutions . You will build robust, scalable data pipelines and deploy predictive models, focusing on engineering excellence and strategic business impact. You will be a transformation agent, utilizing cloud and MLOps technologies to move clients from raw data to sophisticated, real-time AI capabilities.

Areas of Expertise

Data Readiness and Solutions Architecture:

  • Lead the technical implementation and onboarding of core data and cloud platforms, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and BigQuery .
  • Design detailed Feature Stores and event taxonomies to ensure robust data collection for ML models.
  • Implement and support solutions for data governance and quality, ensuring compliance with privacy standards.
  • Solve complex technical challenges, including data unification, real-time feature delivery, and model serving.

Technical Leadership in AI/ML Solutions:

  • Serve as the technical expert for MLOps frameworks and cloud AI platforms (e.g., Vertex AI), leading the full model deployment lifecycle.
  • Design and deploy custom machine learning models (e.g., recommender systems, NLP classification) and integrate them into client business processes.
  • Empower clients to leverage generative AI models and enable the use of Data Clean Rooms for secure, collaborative data analysis.
  • Provide strategic guidance on optimizing the AI/ML solution stack configuration to drive business value and efficiency.

Strategic Analysis and Value Generation:

  • Transform data into business intelligence, generating insights and strategic recommendations for publishers.
  • Create and optimize executive dashboards in tools like Looker Studio .
  • Communicate with high-level stakeholders to present analyses and advocate for recommendations.

Excellence in Technical Support and Consulting:

  • Act as the escalation point for high-complexity technical inquiries regarding setup, data quality, and performance.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues through data pipeline monitoring and log analysis.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks and bottlenecks to ensure the health of client data operations.

The Profile We Are Looking For

We are seeking a professional capable of translating business requirements into technical architecture and raw data into strategic insights.

Essencial Differentials:

  • Experience: Mid-level to Senior (Pleno/Sênior) in Data Engineering, AI/ML Solutions, or Web Analytics.
  • Python Mastery: Deep knowledge of data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, Spark) and ML frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow).
  • BigQuery/SQL Expertise: Solid experience with large-scale data warehousing and feature engineering.
  • Client-Facing DNA: Previous experience in technical client-facing roles (Solutions Engineer, ML Engineer, etc.).
  • Platform Mastery: Proficiency in cloud data platforms (GCP preferred) and MLOps principles.
  • Soft Skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts, structured problem-solving, and a proactive mindset.

High-Impact Differentials:

  • Experience with Vector Databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) .
  • Understanding of the Cloud AI Ecosystem
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for ML models ( MLOps ).
  • Familiarity with Docker for deployment and scaling.

Why join Plexus?

  • Culture of Innovation: A mature and collaborative environment with direct mentorship from founders with unparalleled market experience.
  • Accelerated Growth and Impact: Work at the forefront of technology and position yourself years ahead of the market. Enjoy autonomy and be the architect of data success for major clients.

title: AI & Data Solutions Engineer
description:
About Plexus:

Founded by former leaders from Google, Plexus is a strategic consultancy that bridges the power of data, artificial intelligence, and technology to transform business growth. Our culture is built on technical excellence, a data-driven mindset, and a focus on sophisticated, scalable solutions.

The Role:

Your mission will be to work with our clients to design and implement cutting-edge AI/ML and data solutions . You will build robust, scalable data pipelines and deploy predictive models, focusing on engineering excellence and strategic business impact. You will be a transformation agent, utilizing cloud and MLOps technologies to move clients from raw data to sophisticated, real-time AI capabilities.

Areas of Expertise

Data Readiness and Solutions Architecture:

  • Lead the technical implementation and onboarding of core data and cloud platforms, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and BigQuery .
  • Design detailed Feature Stores and event taxonomies to ensure robust data collection for ML models.
  • Implement and support solutions for data governance and quality, ensuring compliance with privacy standards.
  • Solve complex technical challenges, including data unification, real-time feature delivery, and model serving.

Technical Leadership in AI/ML Solutions:

  • Serve as the technical expert for MLOps frameworks and cloud AI platforms (e.g., Vertex AI), leading the full model deployment lifecycle.
  • Design and deploy custom machine learning models (e.g., recommender systems, NLP classification) and integrate them into client business processes.
  • Empower clients to leverage generative AI models and enable the use of Data Clean Rooms for secure, collaborative data analysis.
  • Provide strategic guidance on optimizing the AI/ML solution stack configuration to drive business value and efficiency.

Strategic Analysis and Value Generation:

  • Transform data into business intelligence, generating insights and strategic recommendations for publishers.
  • Create and optimize executive dashboards in tools like Looker Studio .
  • Communicate with high-level stakeholders to present analyses and advocate for recommendations.

Excellence in Technical Support and Consulting:

  • Act as the escalation point for high-complexity technical inquiries regarding setup, data quality, and performance.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues through data pipeline monitoring and log analysis.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks and bottlenecks to ensure the health of client data operations.

The Profile We Are Looking For

We are seeking a professional capable of translating business requirements into technical architecture and raw data into strategic insights.

Essencial Differentials:

  • Experience: Mid-level to Senior (Pleno/Sênior) in Data Engineering, AI/ML Solutions, or Web Analytics.

title: Técnico eletrônico
description:

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência).

  • Resolução de problemas de produtos e componentes

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono , oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering, Data Analytics, Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados.

INCREASE THE POWER OF YOUR BUSINESS.

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:

❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções em OCC;
  • Apoio na configuração, ajuste e manutenção de workflows em OSF / OSM;
  • Análise e correção de incidentes de baixa e média complexidade;
  • Suporte a ambientes produtivos;
  • Integração entre sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Consumo de Web Services REST e SOAP;
  • Execução de testes técnicos e validações funcionais;
  • Apoio na documentação técnica;
  • Trabalho colaborativo com desenvolvedores pleno e sênior.

❇️ O que esperamos de você – Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com OCC (Oracle Commerce Cloud);
  • Conhecimento técnico ou funcional em OSF (Oracle Storefront Framework) / OSM Framework;
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Consumo de APIs REST e SOAP;
  • Vivência com suporte a ambientes produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).

❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência ou vivência em projetos de telecomunicações;
  • Facilidade de aprendizado e adaptação a novos frameworks.

❇️ O que esperamos de você – Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão de dono;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Trabalho em equipe.

✨ O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$39,71/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeados pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada.
